description: What ONE person has changed about the built-in tools and materials list: what they hid, what a thing costs round here, and anything of their own that was never in the list. Import FORTY-FIRST (no dependencies)
notes: This holds OVERRIDES, not copies. Copying the 140-entry catalogue into every account on sign-up would mean a table full of rows nobody has touched, and a catalogue that can never be improved because everyone holds a snapshot of the day they joined. A row appears here only when someone hides, edits or adds something.
catalogue_id points at an entry in config/supply-catalogue.ts. Blank means this is the user's own, which nothing in the shipped list matches.

hidden is the whole point of the feature: most of the list is things a given person will never touch. Hidden, never deleted - a catalogue entry cannot be removed by a user, because the next version might need it and 'I will never need that' is wrong about twice a year.
default_cost is what it costs round here. Prices are local and personal and the app has no business guessing them, but it can remember what you told it last time.
sizes is comma separated, like tags everywhere else in this app.
Users live in Xano, so user_id is TEXT. Every read filters on it.

title.description: The name, when it has been changed or is the user's own. Primary field

user_id.description: Xano user id as a string. EVERY read filters on this

catalogue_id.description: The built-in entry this changes. Blank for the user's own

default_status.description: How this person usually gets it

favourite.description: Pinned to the top of the picker
